decision.rationale: CCTO already owns the plant cold response API; alternatives provide static thresholds, winter exceptions or unrelated features; none establishes a reusable duration-integrated injury rule.
decision.independent_gap: A short cold excursion and a sustained lethal freeze have different outcomes at the same minimum sampled temperature.
